Armada scenarios exercise effect destruction and effect negation of neutral revived monsters; battle destruction, real card combinations and summon locks remain open. Revenge Division scenarios cover normal doubling, recipient immunity and End Phase expiry.

Last Stand tests cover recycling 0/1/2 Brigade cards among three returns, Spell/field monster negation and GY monster exclusion. Trigger-location ChainInfo is adapted for modern OCGCore. Redirected returns, Trap effects, activation cost failure and repeated-use limits remain open.

Loving Division: hand/GY self-summons, wrong-set/self-only exclusions and same-turn Trap activation from Deck/GY/face-up banishment verified. Native material fixture and FaceupEx compatibility adapter used. Target removal in response, Necrovalley and facedown banishment remain open.

Flowering Division: native hand summons using GY/face-up banished costs, rejection of facedown banished costs, inherited GY/banished recovery and wrong-host exclusion verified. Necrovalley, cost prohibition and shared summon-count boundaries remain open.

Forward Division: first/second Spell resolution, monster activation preceding first Spell, wrong host and detachment verified. Turn-reset, multiple hosts, unnegatable effects and search/summon restriction boundaries remain open.

Lets Go: Deck summon, control-no-monsters boundary, GY search, shared use limit, prior LIGHT/DARK summon checks and subsequent LIGHT lock verified. Negated activation and chained Deck-resource removal remain open.

Melody: native extra Normal Summon/Set allowance, multiple-copy non-stacking and wrong-archetype exclusion verified. Tribute summons, disabled source and source removal after allowance use remain open.

Companion Team: actual opponent effect target selection across faceup/facedown/wrong-set support and opponent attack-triggered Deck summon verified. Once-per-turn repeated attacks, hand summon branch, battle-target selection assertions, unique control and native Link recipe remain open.

Absolute Supremacy: Spell/monster activation negation, activated card plus two same-code GY copies banished, temporary cost and actual End Phase return verified. Activated card leaving before resolution, immunity, unnegatable activation, occupied return zones, battle protection and Link recipe remain open.

Origins: destroy/then-banish normal and failed destruction, detach-two cost boundary, and actual destruction/Tribute Pendulum placement verified. Occupied Pendulum Zones, recipient protection, attach triggers, Necrovalley and native Xyz recipe remain open.

Origins attachment: opponent/own GY event, immune monster, Special Summon and faceup Spell target covered. Modern-core IsCanOverlay adapter is field-only/non-token for the Spell fixture; revive-limit status seeded for Special Summon. Native Xyz/Flip Summon, Trap target and Damage Step remain open.

Heartbeat/Forward: Normal and Special Summon triggers, prior outsider rejection and Brigade-only post-use eligibility verified. Negated effect/activation, full zones and shared repeated-summon use limits remain open.

Joyous Division: GY/faceup banished revival, facedown banishment and wrong-archetype exclusion, opponent-controlled Brigade summon and optional-when timing boundary verified with BreakEffect separating the subsequent draw. Repeated revival count, Necrovalley, occupied zones and chained source movement remain open.

Revenge Division: opponent-removal GY revival, highest opposing faceup ATK damage, own-removal and wrong-archetype exclusions, and revival with zero opponent monsters verified. Proper summon status seeded; battle-caused loss, Necrovalley, highest ATK changing in chain and Standby attachment remain open.

Revenge Standby attachment: Brigade monster and Spell, wrong-archetype exclusion and own-only Standby Phase verified with a second eligible card left in Deck. Multiple source copies, second own turn and chained movement remain open.

Five Brigade Extra Deck recipes: 15 native OCGCore selection scenarios verify legal materials, wrong Level/archetype and Link-material eligibility. Legacy Omega Xyz/Link procedure-signature and field IsFaceupEx adapters used. Xyz material modifiers, higher material counts, field-zone restrictions and live Omega remain open.

Armada draw detach boundary, Hope hand/GY native summon with/without opponent monster and Brigade Field Spell activation-search eligibility verified. Draw ChainInfo adapter used. Shared repeated-use, cost prohibitions and negated activation remain open.

Origins Pendulum protection: native opponent Spell/Trap target selections exclude Brigade monsters; monster effects and wrong-archetype targets remain permitted. Trap fixture has explicit hand-activation permission. Immunity/disabled source and alternate Pendulum Zone remain open.

Stand Together missing material and missing attach-card activation boundaries verified. No hypothetical material-removal lock was introduced; local Omega constants contain no explicit such prohibition.

Both Hope-summoned monsters carry attack/activation restrictions, and both restrictions expire by the next Draw Phase; observer executes native effect queries and returns a marker card after assertions. Companion actual battle target choices now assert supported/unprotected eligibility.

Companion unique-control native permission verified with Link signature adapter. Origins rejects Pendulum placement with both actual Pendulum occupants preserved; helper Spell moved to middle zone to avoid temporarily blocking an outer zone. No unresolved activation discrepancy remains in this test.

Hope native summon count shared between hand copies and hand/GY copies. Flowering count shared between hand copies with another eligible shuffle-cost card still in GY. Negated summons and next-turn reset remain open.

Brigade Field Spell: activation search followed by discard/Xyz effect in same turn, repeat-use rejection and insufficient one-card discard resource verified. Neutral Xyz recipient and FaceupEx adapter used.
Armada named draw limit shared across two field copies, each with a detach resource. Second copy retains one payable material but cannot activate after first copy draws.

Supremacy negation succeeds under a card-specific banishment prohibition, and banishment works with zero matching GY copies. Activated card leaving before resolution with matching GY copies remains unresolved. Official conjunction guide reviewed: https://www.yugioh-card.com/eu/play/understanding-card-text/part-7-conjunction-functions/

Joyous native dice: deterministic seeds cover all six actual OCGCore die results. Choosing maximum verifies ceil(roll/2) banishments and retained GY remainder. No die-result override used; optional lower-count choices and chained GY movement remain open.

Official local Omega c47355498 Necrovalley loaded with neutral Field Spell metadata: Loving GY banish target, Flowering GY shuffle cost and Melody GY banish cost blocked; actual Flowering summon using banished cost remains legal. Full printed Necrovalley immunity exceptions and chained activation remain open.

Official Necrovalley entering by chained fixture effect blocks Loving GY banishment/self-summon and Melody GY attachment after activation. Melody remains banished as its paid cost. Full legal Necrovalley activation-chain construction and immunity exceptions remain open.
